meta.notes: All values from opened notices/documents; null = unknown; 'est.' = analyst estimate. TED notices read from TED eForms XML.

items.product: Aluminiumchlorid-Lösung (AlCl3) – Tankwagen, Hauptkläranlage + KA Am Loddenbach + KA Geist
items.spec: DWA-A 202; Wirksubstanz 58-60 g Al/kg (2.1-2.3 mol Al/kg); per mol WS: Pb<15, Cd<0.2, Cr<15, Cu<15, Ni<20, Hg<0.15, Zn<50 mg, AOX<5; used against filamentous bacteria
items.qty_basis: 500 t/yr x 24 months fixed term (+2x12 months option => up to 2000 t); ±15% volume tolerance
26 t/yr x 24 months; may switch to tanker from 2028

tenders.contract_period: 01.01.2027-31.12.2028 (24 months, fixed price) + 2x12 months extension option, max to 31.12.2030; price escalation via Destatis PPI formula (70% material/20% energy/10% diesel) after 12 months, threshold 2.5%
tenders.delivery_terms: Frei Kläranlage Münster (DDP-type, all freight/packaging/surcharges in unit price), call-offs within max 10 working days, 22-25 t tanker loads into 25 m3 PE tanks (AwSV), tankers with VdTÜV-Merkblatt 953 safety (ANA/ASS), Euro 5 vehicles; IBC return pickup; technical field service on site within 3 days incl. microscopic sludge assessment
tenders.packaging: bulk tanker 22-25 t; IBC 1000 L for Hiltrup
tenders.certificates: Technical data sheet + SDS (latest EHS rules); accredited lab analysis of product not older than 3 months (with bid); reference list of aluminium precipitant supplies to WWTPs last 3 years with quantities; liability insurance; trade register; turnover last 3 years; EU sanctions declaration (Art. 5k Reg. 833/2014)
tenders.eligibility_foreign: Open EU procedure under VgV, GPA-covered (GovernmentAgreementConstraintIndicator=true); e-submission on Vergabe Westfalen; documents in German; no local-only restriction, but technical field service within 3 days and German-language communication required
tenders.award_criteria: 100% price (EUR/t Wirksubstanz, net; cash discount counted if >=14 days)

estimated_value.per_lot: framework maximum amount (whole term up to 48 months)

benchmark_prices.what: Previous award Stadt Münster AlCl3 framework 2025-2026 (31.2 t Al active substance/yr, up to 24 months) – Feralco Deutschland GmbH, award value 281,920 EUR (est. value 331,092)
benchmark_prices.currency_per: EUR/t Al (WS) – est. = 281920/(31.2*2); ~271 EUR/t product at 60 g Al/kg (estimate, assumes value covers 24 months)

benchmark_prices.what: Implied ceiling: framework max 739,000 EUR / (526 t/yr x 4 yr)

tenders.feasibility_ru: Низкая для прямой поставки из Китая/Индии: нужен склад/производство в ЕС (поставки танковозами 22-25 т в течение 10 рабочих дней), техслужба на месте за 3 дня с микроскопией ила, REACH-регистрация AlCl3-раствора, ADR-перевозчик. Реально только через европейского партнёра-производителя (Feralco, Kemira и т.п.) или как субпоставщик. Объём ~526 т/год ≈ 140-180 тыс. EUR/год.
tenders.risks_ru: Действующий поставщик Feralco; цена фиксирована 24 мес; только немецкий язык; требование референций по алюминиевым коагулянтам на очистных; доставка раствора из Азии экономически невыгодна (вода ~85-90% массы).

items.product: Lot 1 RCERO Ljubljana (MBT digestate centrate pre-treatment): coagulant (type not specified beyond tender title "polyelectrolytes"; liquid)
items.spec: Liquid; stored in 20 m3 tank, dosed via Flocmix; must pass mandatory 1-day industrial test on AlfaLaval G3 decanter
Liquid, stored in IBC; industrial test with ~0.5 IBC

items.product: Lot 2 CČN Ljubljana (central WWTP): powder cationic polyelectrolyte, one product for all 4 stations (primary & bio sludge belt thickeners, centrifuge thickening before thermal hydrolysis, digestate centrifuges)
items.spec: Powder in 500 kg big-bags; industrial test 200 kg; exclusion if digestate cake <18% DS or poor centrate

tenders.contract_period: Framework agreement 48 months with up to 5 suppliers per lot; mini-competitions (re-opening of competition) for ~6-month call-off periods
tenders.delivery_terms: Prices EUR/kg excl. VAT DDP (Incoterms 2010) unloaded at RCERO, Cesta dveh Cesarjev 101 / CČN Ljubljana, Cesta v Prod 100, Ljubljana; ADR transport; take-back of packaging
tenders.packaging: Lot 1 bulk tank 20 m3 / IBC; Lot 2 returnable 500 kg big-bags (supplier collects empty bags)
tenders.certificates: SDS and technical sheet; references: lot 1 - min 40 t coagulant + 10 t flocculant delivered to one customer in continuous 12-month period within last 3 years; mandatory industrial test report (Annex 7) signed by buyer; ESPD; Slovenian language (certified translations on request)
tenders.bid_security: No bid bond found in documents; performance guarantee (bank guarantee/insurance bond from bank/insurer seated in Slovenia, first-demand) within 15 days of FA signature
tenders.eligibility_foreign: Open procedure (ZJN-3), GPA-covered EU procedure; foreign bidders allowed via e-JN with ESPD; Slovenian language; mandatory on-site industrial test with up to 2 bidder representatives (registration lot1 by 19.11.2026, lot2 by 01.12.2026 10:00; sludge sample pickup 24-25.11.2026)
tenders.award_criteria: Per documents: price-based (total offer price excl. VAT; lot 1 offer price x dosing kg/t DS from test; lot 2 'cost of treating dry solids' EUR) – evaluated per lot

benchmark_prices.what: Previous award VKS-49/21 (24 months) – Allied Solutions Central Eastern Europe Kft: Lot 1 RCERO 1,314,000 EUR; Lot 2 CČN 450,000 EUR (quantities of 2021 not in notice, unit price not derivable)
Rough implied: 2021 lot 2 450,000 EUR/24 mo vs now 500 t/48 mo => ~1.8 EUR/kg powder (ESTIMATE, assumes same annual volume)

tenders.feasibility_ru: Средне-низкая. Лот 2 (порошковый катионный ПАА в биг-бэгах 500 кг, ~125 т/год) технически подходит для китайского продукта (SNF/китайские аналоги), но обязательное промышленное испытание на станции в Любляне (присутствие представителя, 200 кг пробы, доставка заранее) и банковская гарантия от словенского банка. Нужен партнёр/дистрибьютор в Словении/ЕС и склад для DDP. Лот 1 (жидкие коагулянт+флокулант для фугата MBT) — сложнее.
tenders.risks_ru: Прошлый победитель Allied Solutions (Венгрия); многопоставщиковое рамочное соглашение с переторжкой каждые 6 мес; словенский язык; сроки регистрации на испытания уже близки (19.11 и 01.12.2026).

items.product: Cationic emulsion polymer for digested sludge dewatering (2 decanters)
items.spec: kationische Emulsion; selection by sample trial (streaming potential per DWA M-383) vs current reference product by external expert; price adjustment on propylene/acrylonitrile/methyl acrylate indices every 6 months

items.product: Cationic emulsion polymer for WAS thickening (3 centrifuges)

tenders.contract_period: 4 years (framework, one lot); notice end date 2031-06-30; prices fixed 6 months then 6-monthly adjustment by raw-material formula
tenders.delivery_terms: Fixed price frei Lieferstelle Klärwerk Koblenz incl. all ancillary costs and truck toll; IBCs in batches of max 10; empty IBCs taken back free; delivery lead time (working days) is scored; on-site application service visits and consulting included; field staff must speak German (A2)
tenders.packaging: IBC (max 10 per delivery), returnable free of charge
tenders.certificates: Certificate of analysis for each batch; SDS; product samples min. 100 ml each with bid; 'Schlammprobe mit Dokumentation'; EU sanctions declaration; LTTG Tariftreue declaration; 3 reference certificates; staff numbers last 3 years
tenders.eligibility_foreign: Open EU procedure, GPA-covered; documents and bid only in German; sludge samples must be collected in person at Koblenz on 01.12.2026 (registration by 20.11.2026); no late document re-submission allowed
tenders.award_criteria: Annual cost 55% (EUR/kg HW x expert-determined dosage kg/MgTM x 37,626 MgTM/a) + product suitability from lab trial 35% (0 points = exclusion) + general performance 10%
tenders.feasibility_ru: Низкая: конкурс по результатам лабораторного теста на шламе (забор проб лично в Кобленце 01.12.2026), обязательный сервис-инженер с немецким языком, поставки IBC с возвратом тары. Для трейдера из Китая/Индии реально только через немецкого партнёра-сервисную компанию. Объём 63 т/год эмульсии (~150-200 тыс. EUR/год, оценка).
tenders.risks_ru: Конкуренция SNF, Solenis, Kemira, BASF; 35% баллов — технический тест, 0 баллов = исключение; язык; приёмка проб без возможности дозаявки.
